notes.title: A new DLC add on is now available!
notes.content:
Dear Fritz Fans,

We heard you. You wanted additional add on packages for Fritz Chess such as training videos, etc and we're happy to announce the first release in that series: Bobby Fischer Master Class Vol 1. 

For a limited time, you can enjoy this add on training series at a discount for only $25.99 and after the sale it will be $29.99

Thank you very much for your continued support of Fritz Chess as we work hard to bring you the content you would like to see.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/381970/

notes.title: Fritz For Fun 13 has been updated
notes.content:
We have made some various improvements to Fritz for Fun 13 which should improve the overall reliability of the program. Additionally, within the engines you should now see the Fritz 13 engine. If you have any further issues with the game please feel free to leave us your bug reports on the forums and I will pass them onto the QA team for testing. 

Jason Carver
Community Support at Encore Software
